authorization: User authorized steps 2,3,5 and explicitly deferred external scientific verification and recruitment; separate internal exploratory execution only.
registration: Hash protocol, input cases, executable harness, FAR runtime source and exact comparator versions BEFORE first campaign prediction. Preserve all versions and failures.
controls: All cases and reference labels are project-authored, implementation-exposed, synthetic, not unseen or representative.
Keep premise truth, interpretation fidelity, source applicability, formal inference and factual verdict separate.
Formulas are supplied identically to FAR and SymPy only in the formula track.
Raw-source comparator arms get identical primary/evidence text without one-sided supplied formulas.
Noesis minimal mode is model-free and degraded; absence of its classifier is a configuration limitation, never a FAR superiority claim.
History treatment supplies the same prior source bytes to both systems; compare with a fresh follow-up-only condition.
No external model/API calls, frozen benchmark execution, EFR enrollment or claim promotion.

noesis.configuration: minimal; no external providers or classifier weights

minerval.reason: No configured local stack or authenticated service access; no inferred failure score.

fact_engineering.reason: No authenticated API/account or funded calls configured; no inferred failure score.

metrics.formal: Status agreement, decisive coverage and checked countermodels, with atom-bound abstentions separate.
metrics.raw: Exact reference claim-span recall, citation presence/support assertions kept distinct from truth, factual abstention, actual refusal/degradation, package replay, stage/total elapsed time.
metrics.history: Paired follow-up-only versus retained-source conditions; source retention alone is not semantic/customer utility.
unmeasured: fully attributed compute and human dollar cost
metrics.uncertainty: Exact counts for this enumerated developer corpus only. Repeated local timing is operational observation, not population inference. No binomial CI for dependent synthetic developer cases.

stopping: Stop and retain evidence on integrity drift; capture execution errors and null/adverse outcomes. Do not replace cases after observing outcomes.
